about_the_game:
Seven-Star Mystic

After purchasing the DLC, you can receive the limited mission "Seven Stars Movement" after reaching the third chapter of the game. After completing the series of missions, you can obtain the character's token (unlock the recruitment of the character) and the character's special equipment drawings (unlock new equipment forging).

After reaching the second round, you will receive a new limited mission to obtain the character's special magic weapon drawings (unlock new magic weapon forging).

The Seven-Star Pavilion is an ancient sect deeply attuned to the celestial patterns of heaven and earth. Established in the northern reaches of the Arid Zephyr Continent during an era so ancient that it defies tracing, its location offers an optimal vantage point for observing the heavens.

the pavilion's most esteemed members, have attained mastery over the celestial realm. Their profound understanding of the stars and skies has reached a transcendent level, allowing them to harness the boundless power of the constellations to their will.

In recent times, the Seven-Star Pavilion appears to have uncovered revelations from the celestial omens, prompting them to dispatch disciples to explore the Celestial Realm in search of answers.

Engaging with the Seven-Star Pavilion offers access to their ancient and boundless wisdom, a priceless boon that can greatly aid one’s journey on the path to immortality!

Skills

Stellar Energy

  • Effect: Deals damage to a single enemy based on the user's attack power and elemental attribute.

Lucky Strike Bonus: Restores a portion of the user's mana upon triggering a lucky strike.

Seven-Star Soul Suppression

  • Effect: Summons seven stellar tokens, each dealing damage to a random enemy target based on the user's attack power and elemental attribute.

Starry Sky

When Lucky Hit is triggered:

Apply 10 layers of [Starry Sky] to the target, which lasts until the end of the wave.

After releasing the ultimate move:

Apply 10 layers of [Starry Sky Derivation] to yourself, which lasts until the end of the wave.
